title: Magnetic resonance imaging
source: In Europe, where more gadolinium-containing agents are available, a classification of agents according to potential risks has been released. In 2008, a new contrast agent named gadoxetate, brand name Eovist (US) or Primovist (EU), was approved for diagnostic use: This has the theoretical benefit of a dual excretion path.
translation: 在欧洲，由于含钆造影剂的种类更为丰富，已发布了一份根据潜在风险对造影剂进行分类的指南。2008年，一种名为加塞酸（gadoxetate）的新型造影剂获批用于诊断，其商品名在美国为Eovist，在欧盟为Primovist。该造影剂在理论上具有双重排泄途径的优势。
